AM.T: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.

PM.T: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

AM.T: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

PM.T: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

AM.T: A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honor.

PM.T: and with diligence to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

AM.T: and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

PM.T: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.

AM.T: I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.

PM.T: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

AM.T: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

PM.T: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.

AM.T: Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.

PM.T: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”

AM.T: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth;

PM.T: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.

AM.T: “Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!

PM.T: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

AM.T: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.

PM.T: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

AM.T: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”

PM.T: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

AM.T: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.

PM.T: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints, and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe.

AM.T: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.

PM.T: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.

AM.T: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

PM.T: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

AM.T: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

PM.T: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

AM.T: How sweet are Your words to my taste — sweeter than honey in my mouth!

PM.T: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

AM.T: A good name is more desirable than great riches; favor is better than silver and gold.

PM.T: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.

AM.T: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

PM.T: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

AM.T: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.

PM.T: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;

AM.T: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

PM.T: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.

AM.T: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

PM.T: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.

AM.T: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

PM.T: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

AM.T: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’

PM.T: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.

AM.T: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.

PM.T: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but associate with the lowly. Do not be conceited.

AM.T: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;

PM.T: And in Him, having heard and believed the word of truth — the gospel of your salvation — you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

AM.T: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.

PM.T: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

AM.T: Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

PM.T: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.

AM.T: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.

PM.T: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.

AM.T: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

PM.T: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.

AM.T: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

PM.T: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
